entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Sangam Jain, learned Public Prosecutor for the  respondent-State.

At the very outset, learned counsel for the applicant seeks for and is granted permission to withdraw this fourth repeat bail application under Sections 439 of CrPC filed by the applicant in connection with Crime No.889/2020 registered at Police Station Ambah, District Morena for offence under Sections 420, 272 and 273 of IPC and Sections 51 and 57 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
The application is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.

(Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava)
